young_farmer.label: Young Farmer
young_farmer.visual_dna: A 24-year-old Indian village farmer, lean build, medium brown skin, expressive dark eyes, short slightly messy black hair, thin moustache. Wearing a faded indigo-blue kurta with sleeves rolled up, cream dhoti trousers and worn brown sandals. A faded red cotton scarf rests around his neck. His expressions shift from worry to curiosity and finally quiet wisdom. Maintain identical facial features, clothing, hairstyle and body proportions in every appearance.

old_traveller.label: Old Traveller
old_traveller.visual_dna: A mysterious elderly Indian traveller around 70 years old, slender body, slightly hunched posture, deeply lined face, kind sharp eyes, long white beard and shoulder-length white hair. Wearing a dusty ochre shawl over a simple brown robe, loose cream trousers and old leather sandals. Carries a small wooden walking stick and a weathered cloth shoulder bag. Maintain consistent appearance and clothing.

village_well.label: Ancient Village Well
village_well.visual_dna: An old circular stone well at the edge of a small Indian village, uneven grey-brown stones, a wooden pulley with a thick rope, a small clay water pot nearby, wild grass growing between stones and a large banyan tree leaning over one side. Behind it are distant mud houses, a narrow dusty path and low green fields. The location feels quiet and slightly mysterious. Preserve its recognizable layout.

farmer_hut.label: Farmer's Hut
farmer_hut.visual_dna: A modest Indian village mud hut with faded ochre walls, a sloping thatched roof, a small wooden doorway, a woven charpai, a clay water pot and farming tools leaning against the exterior. Inside, a simple low wooden table, a brass oil lamp, a rolled sleeping mat and a small window. Warm earthy tones and a humble lived-in atmosphere.

golden_seed.label: Golden Seed
golden_seed.visual_dna: A single unusual seed, small and oval, with a warm golden-brown shell and a tiny natural spiral pattern. It has a subtle warm glow, never magical neon light. Keep its size, shape and appearance identical whenever shown.

clay_pot.label: Clay Water Pot
clay_pot.visual_dna: A traditional round reddish-brown earthen water pot with a narrow neck, slightly chipped rim and hand-made uneven surface. Keep the same shape and texture throughout.

beats.narration_text: अगर कोई अजनबी आपको कल की खुशी आज ही दे दे… तो क्या आप उस पर भरोसा करेंगे?
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.old_traveller} standing beside {assets.village_well}, holding {assets.golden_seed} carefully in his open palm. {assets.young_farmer} stands a few steps away, staring at the seed in disbelief. A banyan tree spreads its branches overhead, distant village houses sit beyond the dusty path, and a few dry leaves drift across the foreground. Use a dramatic wide composition with the glowing seed as a tiny focal point between the two characters.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create the opening scene at the same ancient village well. Establish the well, banyan tree, village houses and fields. Introduce both characters with their exact visual designs and the golden seed.

beats.narration_text: एक छोटे से गाँव में, एक किसान हर दिन अपनी किस्मत को कोसता था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.young_farmer} sitting alone on the stone edge of {assets.village_well}, elbows resting on his knees and head lowered. His farming tools lie abandoned beside the dusty path. In the background, green fields stretch toward the village huts, while a dry patch of earth near the well suggests a difficult season. Use a high-angle composition that makes the farmer appear small against the quiet landscape.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the same farmer and village well in daylight from a new elevated camera angle. Preserve the well, banyan tree, village surroundings and the farmer's exact appearance.

beats.narration_text: एक दिन वहाँ एक बूढ़ा मुसाफ़िर आया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.old_traveller} walking along the dusty path toward {assets.village_well}, leaning slightly on his wooden walking stick. His ochre shawl moves in the breeze. {assets.young_farmer} notices him from beside the well and slowly lifts his head. Frame the traveller through tall foreground grass, with the banyan tree and village huts layered behind him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain at the same village well during daylight. Introduce the traveller approaching along the path while preserving the farmer and environment designs.

beats.narration_text: उसने किसान की हथेली पर एक अजीब-सा बीज रख दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of {assets.old_traveller}'s wrinkled hand placing {assets.golden_seed} into the open palm of {assets.young_farmer}. The seed's subtle golden-brown spiral catches a small ray of sunlight. The farmer's blue sleeve and the traveller's ochre shawl frame the hands. The old stone well is softly visible in the background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep both characters at the same well. Focus tightly on the exchange of the golden seed, preserving its exact design and the characters' clothing.

beats.narration_text: मुसाफ़िर बोला, 'इसे बोना… कल तुम्हें इसका फल मिलेगा।'
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.old_traveller} bending slightly toward {assets.young_farmer}, raising one finger as if giving an important instruction. His expression is calm and mysterious. The farmer looks down at {assets.golden_seed} in his palm. The old traveller's walking stick rests against the stone well, and the banyan leaves form a soft frame above them.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Stay beside the same well. Preserve the seed and both character designs; shift the focus to the traveller delivering his mysterious instruction.

beats.narration_text: किसान हँसा, लेकिन फिर भी उसने बीज बो दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.young_farmer} crouching in the small patch of soil beside {assets.farmer_hut}, carefully placing {assets.golden_seed} into the earth. He has a doubtful half-smile. {assets.clay_pot} sits beside the hut doorway, and farming tools lean against the mud wall. The thatched roof and a few green plants create a cozy village setting. Show his hands pressing soil over the seed.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the farmer's hut exterior in soft late-afternoon light. Preserve the farmer's appearance, hut architecture and golden seed.

beats.narration_text: उसने थोड़ा पानी डाला… और रात होने का इंतज़ार किया।
beats.prompt_action: Same hut exterior and same patch of soil. Show {assets.young_farmer} tilting {assets.clay_pot} and pouring a small stream of water onto the newly planted spot. Tiny droplets splash against the earth. His red scarf hangs forward as he bends down. The warm evening sky and hut wall remain in the background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: In the same scene: keep the farmer, hut, soil patch and surroundings identical. Change only his action to pouring water from the clay pot onto the planted seed.

beats.narration_text: सुबह वह दौड़कर बाहर आया…
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.young_farmer} rushing out through the wooden doorway of {assets.farmer_hut}, one sandal slightly lifted mid-stride, his red scarf flying behind him. His eyes are fixed on the patch of soil. The charpai and clay pot are visible in the foreground, while morning sunlight falls across the hut wall and ground. Use a lively diagonal composition to create a sense of sudden movement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the same hut exterior in fresh morning light. Preserve the farmer and hut details; change the camera angle to capture his hurried movement outside.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन वहाँ तो कुछ भी नहीं उगा था!
beats.prompt_action: Same patch of soil beside {assets.farmer_hut}. Show {assets.young_farmer} kneeling and staring at the completely empty earth. He gently scrapes the soil with one finger, looking confused. The empty patch is clearly visible, with the clay pot lying on its side nearby and a few scattered dry leaves.
beats.session_delta_prompt: In the same hut exterior: preserve the soil patch, farmer and morning lighting. Show no plant growing; change only the farmer's action and expression to disappointment.

beats.narration_text: वह गुस्से में बीज को बेकार समझने लगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.young_farmer} sitting back on his heels, holding a tiny empty handful of soil and looking frustrated. His eyebrows are knitted and his lips pressed together. The bare patch of earth fills the lower foreground, while the hut wall and doorway sit behind him. Use an intimate close-up that emphasizes his disappointment.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain at the same hut and empty soil patch. Preserve the farmer's appearance and the morning setting; focus on his frustrated reaction.

beats.narration_text: तभी उसे याद आया… मुसाफ़िर ने कहा था, कल फल मिलेगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.young_farmer} standing beside {assets.village_well}, looking toward the distant dusty road with a thoughtful expression. One hand rests on his chin, while the other holds the red scarf near his chest. The banyan tree casts long shadows across the stone well, and the fields stretch behind him under a pale afternoon sky.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Return to the established village well in afternoon light. Preserve its architecture and the farmer's appearance; show him remembering the traveller's promise.

beats.narration_text: वह बूढ़े आदमी को ढूँढ़ने दौड़ा… पर गाँव में कोई उसे जानता ही नहीं था।

Use a diagonal composition with the farmer in motion in the foreground.

beats.narration_text: शाम तक थककर वह उसी कुएँ के पास लौट आया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.young_farmer} walking slowly back toward {assets.village_well} at sunset, shoulders drooping and head lowered. Long shadows stretch across the dusty path. The banyan tree appears as a dark silhouette against a muted orange sky, and the village houses glow softly in the distance. Use a wide composition with plenty of open space around him to emphasize loneliness.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Return to the same well at sunset. Preserve the well, banyan tree and village layout; change the lighting to warm dusk and show the tired farmer returning.

beats.narration_text: तभी उसकी नज़र मिट्टी पर पड़ी… वहाँ एक नन्हा अंकुर निकला था!

A few droplets cling to the small leaves, and the last warm rays of sunset illuminate the sprout. Use a very low ground-level composition, making the tiny plant feel like a remarkable discovery.

beats.narration_text: वह मुस्कुराया… क्योंकि उसे पहली बार कल पर भरोसा हुआ था।

beats.narration_text: कहते हैं, उस बीज ने अगले दिन फल नहीं दिया…

beats.narration_text: न ही उसके बाद वाले दिन…

beats.narration_text: लेकिन किसान ने पानी देना बंद नहीं किया।

beats.narration_text: कुछ हफ्तों बाद, उस छोटे पौधे पर पहला सुनहरा फल लगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show the once-small plant now bearing one beautiful round golden-brown fruit, subtly resembling the spiral texture of {assets.golden_seed}. {assets.young_farmer}'s hands hover carefully beside it, afraid to touch it. beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the same hut garden location. Show the plant after several weeks of growth with its first golden-brown fruit, preserving the farmer's visual design and the storybook art style.

beats.narration_text: किसान समझ गया… चमत्कार बीज में नहीं, उसके धैर्य में था।

His expression is grateful and thoughtful. The morning sun rises behind the distant fields, birds cross the sky, and the clay pot rests beside the plant.
